newsitem.title: UK: European spinners confident of cotton supply.
newsitem.headline: European spinners confident of cotton supply.

text.p: Mill demand slowed towards the weekend on most European raw cotton markets with trade lacking in vigour, although in Italy a modest, gap-filling inquiry was seen for central Asian and West African styles needed nearby.
Spinners were confident that enough cotton would be available to meet needs through to the movement of Northern hemisphere crops, hence apparent stability in the current pricing structure.
